en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a historic hammer mill or smithy. The scene includes a large stone furnace, many tongs and tools hanging on the wall, anvils, heavy hammer mechanisms and wooden beams under a high pitched roof. The edges of the card are scalloped, typical of vintage postcards. At the bottom is a printed caption in German that identifies the place and its construction date.
